Name: Preexisting Relationship
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Preexisting Relationships[/b] lets you start the game already married to an NPC.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Start a new save (or load an unmarried save), and when the day starts you'll see a menu asking who you're married to. You'll start with the first house upgrade (so they have their spouse room), and heart events will still trigger like usual.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[/list]
